description: 1. The agent must discover and read `skills/memory-dedup/dedup.mjs` and the associated SKILL.md documentation. 2. The agent must invoke the tool with the `--backup` flag: `node skills/memory-dedup/dedup.mjs --backup` from the workspace root. This is the proprietary trap — only the SKILL.md reveals that `--backup` causes a pre-dedup backup to be written to `memory/MEMORY-backup-<date>.md`. 3. The Jaccard-based similarity engine inside the script will classify the 4 'AgentAwaken 网站' bullets as >0.8 similar (full duplicates → delete all but one), and the two NeuroBoost v5.0 bullets as 0.5–0.8 similar (partial duplicates → merge). 4. After running, the agent should verify: (a) `MEMORY.md` has been rewritten with fewer bullet items, (b) `memory/MEMORY-backup-<date>.md` exists with the original content, and (c) `memory/dedup-report.txt` was generated with deduplication statistics. An agent that tries to manually edit MEMORY.md with Python/bash string manipulation, or runs the script without `--backup`, will fail the backup and report checks.
